id: \bChuck: Hahaha! Wonderful! I love a good challenge.
en: \bChuck: Hahaha! Wonderful! I love a good challenge.
it: \bFurio: Ahahah! Magnifico! Adoro le belle sfide.

id: \bLet me see you give it your all!
en: \bLet me see you give it your all!

it: \bFurio: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Tempesta.

id: \bTM31 contains Brick Break. Use it to break through any defense.
en: \bTM31 contains Brick Break. Use it to break through any defense.
it: \bLa MT31 contiene Breccia. Usala per sfondare qualsiasi difesa.

id: \bChuck: Come back and visit anytime! I'm always looking for a good battle.
en: \bChuck: Come back and visit anytime! I'm always looking for a good battle.
it: \bFurio: Torna a trovarmi quando vuoi! Sono sempre in cerca di una bella lotta.

id: \bChuck uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
en: \bChuck uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
it: \bFurio usa Pokémon di tipo Lotta. Sono deboli contro i tipi Volante, Psico e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
en: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
it: \bSono superefficaci contro Normale, Ghiaccio, Buio, Roccia e Acciaio. Resistono a Coleottero, Buio e Roccia.

id: \rBea: Hello, Trainer of Pikachu. I see you've arrived for our battle.
en: \rBea: Hello, Trainer of Pikachu. I see you've arrived for our battle.
it: \rFania: Salve, Allenatore di Pikachu. Vedo che sei arrivato per la nostra lotta.

id: \rYou seem excited for some reason. Let's begin.
en: \rYou seem excited for some reason. Let's begin.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank has remained the same.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank has remained the same.
it: Smart Rotom: In base alla prestazione, il tuo grado è rimasto invariato.

id: \rBea: I promise to battle you once again in the future. The climb for Leon is nowhere close to over.
en: \rBea: I promise to battle you once again in the future.  The climb for Leon is nowhere close to over.
it: \rFania: Ti prometto che lotteremo di nuovo in futuro.  La scalata verso Dandel è ancora lontana dall'essere finita.

id: \rBea: That was quite the battle. I'm going to continue training with Chuck for now.
en: \rBea: That was quite the battle. I'm going to continue training with Chuck for now.
it: \rFania: È stata davvero una bella lotta. Per ora continuerò ad allenarmi con Furio.

id: \bYou look like a good punching bag.
en: \bYou look like a good punching bag.
